author: felicepantaleo
body:
This PR fixes the IB build after #51919. The IBs `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-09-1100` and `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-09-2300` do not have `pluginRecoTICLPatternRecognitionPlugins.so`, `pluginRecoTICLLinkingPlugins.so` and `pluginRecoTICLInterpretationPlugins.so`, and they have no cfi files of these packages. Every Phase-2 RECO configuration then fails with `No module named 'RecoTICL.PatternRecognition.trackstersProducer_cfi'`.

Fix:
 - The implementations of `TracksterInferenceByDNN`, `TracksterInferenceByCNN` and `TracksterInferenceByPFN` move from `RecoTICL/Inference/plugins` to the `RecoTICL/Inference` library. The plugin registrations stay in `plugins`.
 - A new helper, `ticl::inferencePluginPSetDescription<T>(type)`, fills the PSet description from `T::fillPSetDescription` and then adds `type`. This is the order that `edm::PluginDescription` uses. The three producers use it for their six inference PSets.
title: RecoTICL: write the cfi of the TICL producers without the inference plugins
